description: Returns an owned vault job receipt (job_id/status); read the exact job with job_service.get_job for its public terminal outcome. Generate a private random canary, store it, retrieve and compare it internally, then delete only that canary before returning bounded boolean proof fields. The canary and its value are never returned.
embedding_description: Vault qualification: private canary store, retrieve, compare, and cleanup. Returns stored, retrieved, matched, and deleted booleans only; never a canary identifier or value. Registered execution returns job_id/status; the complete public outcome is in job.result. Secret operands remain volatile and failures are sanitized; uncertain effects require reconciliation, never automatic replay.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued vault job receipt. Completed public outcome: Bounded private-canary proof: stored, retrieved, matched, and deleted.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Treat any false proof field as a failed vault qualification and diagnose the local Keychain.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Runs a private Keychain canary and deletes it before returning any result.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: A false proof field identifies the failed stage without exposing the canary or its value.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Verify Keychain availability and permissions, then retry the bounded qualification.
